title: Dental PPO Plans Network Coinsurance Schedule for Reprocessed Grace-Period Lines
content:
The coinsurance a Dental PPO Plans line reprocessed after a not-eligible denial made during a premium grace period (a reprocessed grace-period line) is figured at follows its network status, and so decides the patient share:
- basic-class line from an out-of-network practice: the plan's out-of-network basic percentage;
- major-class line from an out-of-network practice: the plan's out-of-network major percentage;
- preventive-class line from an out-of-network practice: the plan's out-of-network preventive percentage;
- any other line: the plan's in-network percentage for its service class.

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Out-of-network preventive | 100 | 90 | 90 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Out-of-network basic | 0 | 60 | 70 | 80 | 80 | 90 |
| Out-of-network major | 0 | 0 | 40 | 50 | 50 | 60 |
| In-network preventive | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| In-network basic | 0 | 70 | 80 | 80 | 90 | 90 |
| In-network major | 0 | 0 | 50 | 50 | 60 | 60 |

(percentages; any PPO or Premier in-network line takes the in-network row for its class)

Hypothetical: a preventive cleaning from an out-of-network practice on Classic 1250 is figured at 90 percent; the same cleaning in network at 100 percent.
